final: WITH patient_groups AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB / (HCT / 100.0)) AS patient_avg FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), first_overall AS (SELECT AVG(patient_avg) AS avg1 FROM patient_groups), first_kept AS (SELECT p.patient_avg, p.patient_avg - f.avg1 AS diff1 FROM patient_groups AS p CROSS JOIN first_overall AS f WHERE p.patient_avg > f.avg1), second_overall AS (SELECT AVG(patient_avg) AS avg2 FROM first_kept), final_kept AS (SELECT k.patient_avg, k.diff1, k.patient_avg - s.avg2 AS diff2 FROM first_kept AS k CROSS JOIN second_overall AS s WHERE k.patient_avg > s.avg2) SELECT AVG(patient_avg) AS avg_patient_group_average, AVG(diff1) AS avg_difference_from_first_overall, AVG(diff2) AS avg_difference_from_second_overall FROM final_kept
